metadata.description: Standards bypass configuration for this branch

bypass.reason: Auth routing requires importing @api gateway module -- per Phase 4 spec
Type errors from dynamic import guard for Google API -- get_drive_service returns object, Drive API methods unresolvable at static analysis time
googleapiclient.http is a runtime dependency not installed in dev -- guarded by try/except ImportError
Internal helpers called at runtime by upload handler -- not statically reachable from module layer
clean_tracker is called during sync when limit=0 -- runtime path not statically reachable
Legacy path builders (build_versioned_path, build_log_dir, build_drive_path) kept for backward compat and future use
save_project_config is public API surface for settings module (deferred)
list_projects is public API surface for status/discovery commands
format_result is public API surface called by CLI display layer

result.py is one dataclass and no function: it reads and writes no JSON and performs no operation to log. Its callers log the run it describes (build_metadata, append_changelog, the lanes' trail rows). Decision of @backup 2026-10-24.

Checker reads failure guards as the success path. Success is True (92), True/False (136) or a folder id str (148, 173, 198, 239, 256, 321); every other return of the same False/None is itself a no-service/no-answer failure. Decision of @backup, fleet green leg 5; lines re-pointed 2026-10-24 after the 10-23 client.py fixes moved them.

_revoke_public_access returns True only on success; its two other False returns are the could-not-list and could-not-delete failures the docstring names. Checker reads failure guards as the success path. Decision of @backup, fleet green leg 5.

needs_upload answers True on a path it cannot relativise or stat, on purpose and named in its docstring: the upload that follows reports the real failure, where False would skip the file silently on every run. Decision of @backup, fleet green leg 5.
